description: Replacing eventual nonstrict inequalities by strict inequalities leaves boundedness, unboundedness, and domination unchanged. If g bounds a family, n ↦ g(n)+1 strictly bounds it.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.strict_comparison_conventions (B : Set (ℕ → ℕ)) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsBounded B ↔
      ∃ g, ∀ f ∈ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT f g) ∧
    (∀ (g : ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ f ∈ B, f ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] g) → ∀ f ∈ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT f fun n => g n + 1) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsUnbounded B ↔
          ∀ (g : ℕ → ℕ), ∃ f ∈ B, ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT f g) ∧
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsDominating B ↔
          ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), ∃ g ∈ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT f g)
